constructor assigns the initial gov address

_withdrawCollateral invokes minter.withdraw on the stored minter
_settleExpired invokes minter.settleExpired on the stored minter

enter calls withinBounds before executing the mint path

exit calls _burnLPToken to remove liquidity

minter.redeem executes external code before subsequent balance reads and transfers
